title: Machine learning models based on chest computed tomography for identifying plastic bronchitis in children with Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia.
summary: Machine-learning models using chest CT findings identified plastic bronchitis among children with Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia; the source reports diagnostic performance in its clinical cohort.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis applies the stated model to the paper’s computer science dataset and evaluates the reported outcome.
